label: Vinted Pro
terms_note: Vinted Pro business account that Vinted has allow-listed for integrations; keys from the Integrations Portal; initial 500 active items per API user (raise after a 30-day performance review); batch ≤ 100 items; markets AT / BE / DE / ES / FR / IT / LU / NL / PT / UK; second-hand / resale focus.

discovery.auth: hmac (access keys from the Vinted Pro Integrations Portal; HMAC-SHA256 request signing; allow-listed businesses only)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the auditor.
auth: 1. Business is allow-listed by Vinted for the Pro Integrations programme.
2. Generate access keys in the Vinted Pro Integrations Portal; sign every request (HMAC-SHA256).
3. Register webhooks (signature-verified) for item + order events.

endpoints.purpose: create / update / delete items using Vinted ontologies
endpoints.notes: category, brand, colour, size, condition, price, photos

endpoints.purpose: max recommended price by category / brand / condition
orders with buyer / seller addresses; cancel; relist cancelled escrow orders
item created / updated / deleted, sold, order status, auth failures

reference.limits: Not numeric on the page; 500 active-item allocation per API user (review after 30 days); batch 100. - Allow-listed Vinted Pro businesses only. - Item cap 500 until reviewed.
mcp_sdk: none official found in the pages opened

fields.name: access_key
fields.help: Access key: the part BEFORE the comma of the access token generated in the Vinted Pro Integrations Portal (tokens are shown only once; production and dev mode have separate tokens); sent as X-Vpi-Access-Key.

fields.name: signing_key
fields.help: Signing key: the part AFTER the comma of the same access token. Signs every request (hex HMAC-SHA256 over '<unix seconds>.<METHOD>.<path+query>.<access key>.<body>', sent as X-Vpi-Hmac-Sha256: t=<ts>,v1=<hash>); never sent on the wire.

adapter.terms: Vinted Pro Integrations is available only to allow-listed Vinted Pro businesses; each API user starts with 500 active item slots. Item writes are asynchronous (202; results via webhooks or GetItemStatus).

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists one item created through the integration ({items[]}) to verify the access key and signature.

end_listing.note: DeleteItems DELETE /api/v1/items {item_ids: [uuid]} DELETES the item from Vinted asynchronously (202); `listing_id` is the VPI item_id (uuid). raw.accepted is false (with a reason) when the item cannot be deleted, e.g. still IN_PROGRESS.

list_orders.note: GetOrders returns {orders: [{id, status, created_at}]} (status CREATED|READY_TO_BE_SHIPPED|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|LOST|RETURN_*|...). Paging is by the after-id cursor, and there are no status/date filters, so `status`, `since` and page numbers are not applied; amounts and items are in GetOrder.

not_offered.create_listing: CreateItems requires brand, catalog_id, package_size_id, currency, photo_urls and the category's item attributes resolved from GetOntologies; the vocabulary has no catalogue, brand or package size.
not_offered.update_listing: UpdateItems replaces the whole item: brand, catalog_id, currency, description, package_size_id, photo_urls, price, title and is_draft are all required for every update, so a price-only change is not possible.
not_offered.set_inventory: Vinted items are single second-hand listings without a stock quantity; there is no stock endpoint.
not_offered.mark_shipped: Shipping uses the Vinted-issued label (GetOrderShipmentLabel) and the carrier's own tracking; there is no call to submit a carrier and tracking number.

evidence: host pro.svc.vinted.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
